bio: Dr. Varaprasad Venkata Sumanth is a highly regarded pulmonologist dedicated to advanced respiratory care in Badvel and surrounding regions. With qualifications including MBBS, DNB, FSM, and CCEBDM, and experience as a former Consultant Pulmonologist and Assistant Professor, he brings academic excellence and clinical expertise to Sri Srinivasa Hospital. His practice focuses on asthma, COPD, lung diseases, respiratory medicine, and critical care — delivering compassionate, evidence-based treatment for every patient.
